name: Winbond Electronics Corporation
summary: Winbond Electronics Corporation engages in the research, development, production and sales of integrated circuits, various semiconductor components and other system products. The company offers customized memory solutions, including CUBE(3DCaaS), pseudo static random access memory, DDR/SDR, LPDDR/LPSDR, Known Good Die wafer products; electrical simulation, wafer-level speed testing, and other services; redistribution layers; and failure analysis services, as well as low power SDR, DDR, DDR2, DDR3, and DDR4/4X SDRAM products.
